name: Water Pump
description: Simulates a single-stage centrifugal water pump. Set the inlet stream conditions and desired outlet pressure to compute the outlet state and shaft power consumption.
author: DWSIM Automation

name: Heat Exchanger
description: Counter-current shell-and-tube exchanger cooling hot water with cold methanol (NRTL). Set both inlet streams, the area and the overall heat-transfer coefficient; DWSIM rates the exchanger and returns both outlet temperatures, duty and LMTD.
author: DWSIM Automation

name: Gas Compressor
description: Adiabatic compressor raising methane pressure (Peng-Robinson). Set the inlet conditions, discharge pressure and adiabatic efficiency to get the discharge temperature and the shaft power required.
author: DWSIM Automation

name: Shortcut Distillation Column
description: Benzene/toluene column designed with the Fenske-Underwood-Gilliland shortcut method (Peng-Robinson, total condenser). Set the feed, reflux ratio and key-component specs to get minimum reflux, number of stages, feed stage and condenser/reboiler duties.
author: DWSIM Automation
